title: MandateGuard Declared Mandate Envelope
description: PSP-side declared authorization contract. V1 verifies consistency after this boundary; it does not claim that a DECLARED_ONLY mandate is identical to the human's private original intent. The issuer attestation covers payload only. Top-level metadata is explicitly non-authoritative and excluded from authorization hashes/signatures.

nonce.description: Single-use authorization nonce in V1. Any second execution attempt with a consumed nonce is an A4 replay violation; multi-use mandates are out of scope.

subject_ref.description: Opaque reference to the authorizing subject. Do not place raw PII here.

currency.description: ISO-4217 style three-letter currency code, e.g. INR.

max_total_minor.description: Maximum total in minor currency units. Enforced by B6 against the declared total and by A7 against the catalog-derived total.

max_quantity.description: Maximum aggregate execution quantity enforced by B7.

recurring_allowed.description: Mandate recurrence permission enforced by B8 against self-report and A8 against catalog recurrence where available.

issuer_attestation.description: Attestation over the canonical mandate payload only. Top-level metadata is not covered and must never influence authorization decisions.

attestation_ref.description: Opaque reference for a future upstream trust anchor. MandateGuard does not interpret protocol-specific semantics in V1.

metadata.description: Non-authoritative display/debug metadata. Excluded from mandate payload hashes and issuer signatures and forbidden as an authorization source. Integers are allowed; floating-point values are intentionally excluded to preserve deterministic serialization conventions across the codebase.
